label.purpose: Navigation groups, metadata, and table headings.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact decisive action using Action Blue.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.47 0.16 258); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Input
components.description: Compact field with explicit keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--ring); }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Quiet selected surface with a small blue interaction cue.
components.html: Connections
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font: 600 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Crucible DB feels like infrastructure software made by and for engineers: direct, compact, and dependable. Neutral surfaces carry the work, blue identifies interaction, and orange is limited to the Crucible brand.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral canvas with white work surfaces
Compact desktop density with responsive structural changes
Orange reserved for product identity; blue reserved for interaction
Monospaced data for SQL, endpoints, identifiers, and timestamps
Flat-by-default layering with borders and spacing instead of shadow

rules.name: The Brand Boundary Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies Crucible DB; it does not indicate ordinary actions or selected navigation.

rules.name: The Semantic Integrity Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and blue never decorate neutral content. They always communicate state.

rules.name: The Exact Data Rule
rules.body: SQL, endpoints, identifiers, timestamps, and database names use monospace; ordinary prose never does.

rules.name: The Work Stays Flat Rule
rules.body: Tables, filters, sections, and dashboard content never receive decorative shadows.

dos: Do organize navigation around Work, Data, and Admin.
Do keep approval, risk, schedule, execution, and access state visible near the object.
Do use 36px controls and compact table rows for repeated desktop workflows.
donts: Don't resemble a generic CRUD admin template, decorative SaaS dashboard, Cloudflare clone, or toy SQL editor.
Don't use oversized marketing headers, vanity metric cards, nested card layouts, decorative gradients, or glass effects.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, or decorative status colors.
